stations.title: Dario
stations.note: At ten in the morning. CPC-12.

stations.title: Dock board
stations.text: Next three tours, then the day.

captions: With the receipts fixed, Dario says the dock board shows the wrong next tours.
At ten in the morning it puts 17:00 first, and the whole day is scrambled too.
You catch it, fix the order and leave the timetable alone, in three tasks.
Now the next tours come up in time order and the day stays as written.
Same timetable, same board. People queue for the right boat.
